scope: Independent visual inspection of actual PNGs and requested references. No source edits, runtime import, canonical selection or 3D acceptance. Diagnostics are review-only derivatives.

reviews.identity: Young blond warrior, raised bronze Corinthian helmet, red crest and cloak, bronze brooch and cuirass match the existing project concept. Both eyes visible; no text, frame, watermark, hands or weapons.
limits: Central circular crop diameter 0.76 clips the crest; the head including helmet is not wholly inside the requested safe circle.
Full-source centered circle diameter 1.00 retains the crest and face. At 80 px the tall crest makes the face small; review diagnostic includes both crops at native size.
Square edges retain the silhouette. Navy background has subtle texture/value variation rather than an exact solid token.
reviews.recommendation: Keep as original source candidate. For future runtime use choose an explicit crop preserving crest, or request a separate crop-safe correction. This is not runtime acceptance.

reviews.reference: art/imagegen/hero-quality-v1/reference/medusa-quality-reference.png (craftsmanship only); text-only roster provenance in heroes/wolf/provenance.json
reviews.identity: One natural grey quadruped wolf, one head, two ears, one low tail, four clearly distinguishable legs/paws. Nose points left; adult canine proportions and closed mouth read clearly. Neutral alert posture with all paws planted on one low dark stone base. No antlers, gear, magic, team band or text.
limits: This is a single exploratory side view, not a consistent multi-view package. No front/back or rig compatibility has been established.
Fur silhouette has many sharp tufts; a future game mesh needs fewer broader clumps and thickness checks.
Head and paws have slight perspective, and a narrow base top/rim is visible. Do not use as a strict orthographic tracing plate without review.
reviews.recommendation: Keep as the missing Leshen sidekick design reference. Do not submit through humanoid 3D/rig pipeline or claim 1a/1b/1c/game acceptance.

reviews.identity: Leather jerkin, green cloak, conical helmet, axe in own right hand and boar-painted shield on own left match the card. Face and full body visible; no text or team band. Base reads edge-on.
limits: Shield still hides the left forearm/elbow; no clear charcoal-background gap for both arms.
Cloak still fills space beside torso and legs; geometry inference remains ambiguous.
The alternative was created independently of the already accepted canonical 1a. It must not overwrite the canonical source or inherit its acceptance hash.
reviews.recommendation: Archive as optional unselected alternative. Proceed with canonical accepted Wiglaf for downstream work unless a fresh explicit selection is recorded.
